source.cubeTitleEn: Job vacancies and average offered hourly wage by occupation (unit group), quarterly, unadjusted for seasonality
source.definitionQuote: A job is vacant if it meets the following conditions: it is vacant on the reference date (first day of the month) or will become vacant during the month; there are tasks to be carried out during the month for the job in question; and the employer is actively seeking a worker outside the organization to fill the job.
source.nocVersionQuote: The occupational data are presented in this table according to the National Occupational Classification (NOC) 2021 version 1.0.
